decisions.reason: Cloud transactional email is the flagship direction and builds directly on the firm's core messaging infrastructure and expertise.
Document capture and recognition is adjacent to existing document workflow and file exchange capabilities, though it requires some new OCR knowledge the firm can likely absorb.
Email and fax conversion leverages the firm's established messaging and fax service knowledge, making it easy to assimilate and improve.
Fax delivery optimization is an incremental feature built on existing fax and messaging delivery know-how.
Email sandbox threat protection extends the firm's existing secure email and messaging capabilities into a related security area.
Multi-engine email virus scanning builds on the firm's email security and partner integration knowledge, fitting its secure messaging portfolio.
